leather.name: Leather Armor
leather.description: Takes 1 less damage from every hit.

chain.name: Chain Mail
chain.description: Takes 2 less damage, but you move a little slower.

warden_plate.name: Warden Plate
warden_plate.description: Takes 1 less damage and you can't be poisoned.

fur_coat.name: Fur Coat
fur_coat.description: Takes 1 less damage and you can't be slowed by ice.

mystic_robe.name: Mystic Robe
mystic_robe.description: Takes 1 less damage and your MP refills three times as fast.

sun_plate.name: Sun Plate
sun_plate.description: Takes 3 less damage. Fire can't burn you and ice can't slow you.
